response.overview: In The Thing About Art, Joaquín Aras revisits the figure of Rubén Santantonin, a decisive influence on younger informalist artists who referred to his work as 'things'. Full of references to science fiction B-movies and techniques taken from experimental cinema - such as scratching designs directly onto fim - the flim tells the story of an 'alien' object that fails to earth and is installed as an object in an art gallery exhibition. In doing so, he offers a humorous reflection on deformity and inspiration in art.]
response.title: The Thing About Art
